ReturningToPrayer.6: Ingene ugaruka mu salat nyuma y’imihango, utuje mu mutima.
ReturningToPrayer.8: Ibi bikorwa vyose ni vyo kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy’idini bigenzurwe n’abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibwirizwa ry’idini ryihariye.
ReturningToPrayer.11: Uburyo bushobora guhinduka hakurikijwe ishuri ry’amategeko
ReturningToPrayer.12: Gusubira mu salat, utariheza salat zasanzwe
ReturningToPrayer.14: Ghusl ni ukwiyuhagira kwa gatagatifu: ni ukwoza umubiri wose ufise umugambi wo kugaruka mu mubiri uboneye (tahara), ukenewe kugira ubone gukora salat n’ibindi bikorwa vyo gusenga.
ReturningToPrayer.15: Imbere yo gukora ghusl, ni vyiza kwemeza ko imihango yarangiye vy’ukuri: ghusl ikwiye gukurikira, atari ugutanga imbere, kwemera ko amaraso yahagaze. Mu rusangi, iherezo ryamenyekana igihe amaraso yahagaze rwose, kandi bikaba bimaze igihe gihagije cogira ngo ikibazo cose gishire — ico kigasobanurwa neza mu nyandiko yihariye ku mubiri uboneye.
ReturningToPrayer.16: Uku kwiyeza ni ko gutuma usubira mu bihe vyo gusenga vyari vyahagaze mu gihe c’imihango.
ReturningToPrayer.18: Nta mpamvu yo kwihuta: ghusl ishobora gukorwa uhejeje kwitegura, nta gahato, iyo iherezo ry’imihango ryemejwe neza.
ReturningToPrayer.19: Ghusl ishingiye ku mahame rusangi: umugambi wo kwiyeza, no kwoza umubiri wose, harimwo imisatsi n’uruhu. Nyamara utuntu twihariye tw’uburyo bushobora guhinduka hakurikijwe ishuri ry’amategeko ukurikiye.
ReturningToPrayer.21: Nta buryo na bumwe bwerekanwa hano nk’ubwonyine bwemewe: kwisunga ishuri canke ico gitekerezo ukurikira, canke gusaba inama umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi, bizogufasha kumenya utuntu twihariye tujanye n’uko uri.
ReturningToPrayer.22: Imihango irangiye kandi ghusl ikozwe, salat irasubira bisanzwe, nta gutinda kwihariye canke ikindi gisabwa.
ReturningToPrayer.23: Ni vyiza gutandukanya ibintu bibiri bikurikiza amategeko atandukanye: salat zitakozwe mu gihe c’imihango ntizisubirwamwo mu rusangi, mu gihe iminsi yo kwiyiriza yasibwe muri Ramadan ikwiye gusubirwamwo nyuma (qada).
ReturningToPrayer.24: Nk’akarorero, umugore yamaze iminsi 6 mu mihango arasubira muri salat bisanzwe nyuma ya ghusl, ata salat zo muri iyo minsi 6 asabwa gusubiramwo. Ariko iminsi 6 yo kwiyiriza ijanye na yo izosubirwamwo nyuma ya Ramadan.
ReturningToPrayer.26: Gukora ghusl (kwiyuhagira kwa gatagatifu) kugira ugaruke mu mubiri uboneye
ReturningToPrayer.27: Gusubira muri salat bisanzwe, nta gutinda
ReturningToPrayer.28: Kumenya ko salat zasibwe mu gihe c’imihango zitsubirwamwo mu rusangi
ReturningToPrayer.29: Gusaba inama umuhanga abifitiye ubushobozi mu kibazo cose cihariye canke iyo ugishidikanya
ReturningToPrayer.30: Ghusl no kugaruka mu salat — AWA

SideEffects.6: Zimwe mu ngaruka zirashobora kuba zisanzwe kandi z’akanya gato. Izindi zisaba kwitonderwa cane. Menya gutandukanya ivyo umubiri ukunda gukora n’ibimenyetso bikwiye gusuzumwa.
SideEffects.12: Igihe cyo kuja kwa muganga vuba
SideEffects.14: Umuntu atangura uburyo bushasha bwa contraception ya hormone, umubiri ushobora gukenera akanya kugira wimenyereze. Impinduka nto zishobora kugaragara mu mihango, mu mutima canke mu mererwe y’umubiri.
SideEffects.15: Izo ngaruka akenshi ziba zoroheje kandi zishobora kugabanuka buhoro buhoro. Kuba zihari ntibisobanura ko ubwo buryo buteye akaga canke ko bukwiye guhagarikwa.
SideEffects.17: Amaraso adahoraho ashobora kuboneka, cane cane mu ntango y’uburyo bushasha.
SideEffects.19: Amabere ashobora kwumva afunze canke arwaye mu kanya gato.
SideEffects.21: Bamwe bitegereza impinduka mu mutima canke gukunda kurira cane.
SideEffects.23: Umutwe woroheje ushobora kuboneka mu gihe c’imenyerezwa.
SideEffects.24: Ibyumweru canke imihango ya mbere bishobora gutandukana n’ivyo wari wimenyereye. Umubiri ushobora kwimenyereza buhoro buhoro kuri hormone nshasha.
SideEffects.26: Ingaruka ibonetse nyuma yo gutangura uburyo ikwiye kwitegerezwa uko iminsi igenda. Iyo ibaye ikibazo canke ikaguma, vugana n’umuganga.
SideEffects.27: Ni vyiza kwandika ibimenyetso muri porogaramu yawe kugira umenye neza uko bihinduka kuva mu mihango umwe ukaja mu wundi.
SideEffects.32: Itegereze niba gitera imbere canke gikomera.
SideEffects.33: Ibimenyetso vyose ntibijanye na contraception. Guhagarika umutima, ibitotsi, ivyo urya, imihango yawe, canke indi miti na vyo bishobora guhindura uko wumva.
SideEffects.34: Kugira usobanukirwe n’ikibazo, gerageza kurora ibintu vyose hamwe aho kurora ikimenyetso kimwe gusa.
SideEffects.40: Ibi bimenyetso bimaze igihe kingana iki?
SideEffects.41: Vyatanguye nyuma yo gutangura canke guhindura uburyo bwa contraception?
SideEffects.42: Biroroshe, biraguhangayikishije, canke biratangaje kuri wewe?
SideEffects.43: Biragenda biroroha uko iminsi igenda canke biragenda bigaruka kenshi?
SideEffects.44: Naho ikimenyetso kitihutirwa, gishobora kuba ngombwa kukivuganako iyo kibaye ikibazo, kiguma, canke gihindura mu vy’ukuri imibereho yawe.
SideEffects.45: Birashobora kuba vyiza gusaba inama iyo…
SideEffects.46: ibimenyetso biguma, bigakomera, canke bikubuza kubaho bisanzwe.
SideEffects.47: Muganga, umubyaaza, canke umuntu w’imiti arashobora kugufasha kumenya niba ibimenyetso bishobora kuba bijanye n’uburyo ukoresha, no kumenya niba bukwiye guhindurwa.
SideEffects.48: Ibimenyetso bimwe ntibisanzwe kandi bisaba gusuzumwa vuba n’umuganga. Ntibisobanura ko hariho ingorane, ariko ntibikwiye kwirengagizwa.
SideEffects.50: Saba inama z’abaganga vuba iyo ufise, cane cane:
SideEffects.53: Kubyimba canke kuribwa ukuguru mu buryo butamenyerewe
SideEffects.54: Umutwe utunguranye, ukomeye cane canke utamenyerewe
SideEffects.55: Ingorane zitunguranye zo kubona, kuvuga canke imbaraga
SideEffects.57: Ibimenyetso nibiba bitunguranye, bikomeye cane, canke bijanye no kubura umwuka, kwumva ugiye kugwa, canke ikindi kimenyetso gikomeye, saba ubufasha bwihuse bw’abaganga.
SideEffects.59: Zimwe mu ngaruka zishobora kugaragara mu ntango y’uburyo bushasha bwa contraception ya hormone.
SideEffects.60: Ingaruka nyinshi ni iz’akanya gato kandi zishobora kugabanuka uko iminsi igenda.
SideEffects.61: Ikimenyetso kibangamira canke kiguma kikwiye kuvugwako n’umuhanga.
SideEffects.62: Ibimenyetso bimwe bidasanzwe bisaba inama z’abaganga vuba.
SideEffects.64: Kwumviriza umubiri wawe ntibisobanura buri gihe guhagarika uburyo ako kanya. Andika ico wumva, itegereze uko gihinduka, kandi usabe inama igihe cose ikimenyetso kiguhangayikishije.
SideEffects.65: Iyi nyandiko ni iyo kumenyesha kandi ntisimbura inama z’abaganga zihariye. Iyo ufise ikimenyetso gikomeye canke kidasanzwe, saba inama umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima.

SleepHormones.6: Impamvu ibitotsi vyawe bihinduka hakurikijwe icigero c’uruziga rwawe, no mu gihe cya menopause.
SleepHormones.8: Impamvu hormone zigira ingaruka ku bitotsi
SleepHormones.14: Progesterone ifise ingaruka yoroheje yo gutuma usinzira; iyo igabanutse mu herezo ry’uruziga, ishobora kuvangira ibitotsi, bigatuma biba byoroheje canke bikavunika.
SleepHormones.16: Izamuka ritoya ry’ubushuhe bw’umubiri nyuma ya ovulation rishobora kandi gutuma gusinzira bigorana gatoya kuri bamwe.
SleepHormones.18: Kutorohera mu mubiri n’umunaniro bishobora gutuma ibitotsi biba byoroheje.
SleepHormones.20: Ibitotsi mu rusangi biba bihamye cane kuri benshi.
SleepHormones.22: Kugabanuka kwa progesterone kurashobora gutuma ibitotsi biba byoroheje, ukaba wakangutse.
SleepHormones.23: Muri menopause, kubira ibyuya nijoro ni impamvu isanzwe yo gukanguka, ku mpamvu za hormone zisa.
SleepHormones.24: Guhagarika umutima bishobora gukomeza ivyo bibangamira ibitotsi mu bigero vy’uruziga bisanzwe biba bitoroshe. Uburyo bworoshe bwo kuruhuka (guhumeka, kwaguramwo umubiri buhoro) bushobora kugufasha kuruhuka imbere yo kuryama.
SleepHormones.25: Umugenzo uhamye wo kuryama n’icumba gikonje bifasha kugabanya ivyo bibangamira, mu myaka yose.
SleepHormones.27: Kuryama no gukanguka mu masaha ahoraho bifasha gutunganya isaha y’umubiri wawe.
SleepHormones.29: Umucyo w’ubururu urashobora gutinza gusinzira; kuruhuka kuri ecran biragufasha kuruhuka.
SleepHormones.31: Ubushuhe buringaniye bworohereza gusinzira, mu myaka yose.
SleepHormones.32: Imigenzo myiza ntihora ihagije. Gushobora kuba vyiza kuvugana n’umuhanga iyo:
SleepHormones.34: Ingorane z’ibitotsi zimaze ibyumweru bitari bike
SleepHormones.35: Umunaniro uragira ingaruka zikomeye ku mibereho ya buri musi
SleepHormones.36: Kubura ibitotsi biguma naho ufise imigenzo myiza
SleepHormones.38: Kwandika igihe ingorane zimaze n’ivyo bisa nk’ibigiramwo ingaruka bishobora gufasha umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima kukuyobora neza.
SleepHormones.40: Izi mpinduka z’ibitotsi ni zisanzwe kandi akenshi ni iz’akanya gato: ntizisobanura ko hari ikitagenda.
SleepHormones.41: Progesterone ifise ingaruka yoroheje yo gutuma usinzira; iyo igabanutse mu herezo ry’uruziga, ishobora kuvangira ibitotsi.
SleepHormones.42: Muri menopause, kubira ibyuya nijoro ni impamvu isanzwe yo gukanguka.
SleepHormones.43: Umugenzo uhamye wo kuryama n’icumba gikonje bifasha kugabanya ivyo bibangamira, mu myaka yose.
SleepHormones.44: Ingorane z’ibitotsi ziguma zikwiye kuvugwako n’umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima.
SleepHormones.45: Amakuru yo kumenyesha. Iyi nyandiko ntisimbura inama z’abaganga zihariye. Iyo ushidikanya, saba inama umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima.
SleepHormones.46: Ibitotsi na hormone: isano idasanzwe — AWA

UnderstandCycle.8: Ibigero nyamukuru vy’uruziga rwawe, bisobanuwe mu buryo bworoshe.
UnderstandCycle.19: Buri gicero gifise uruhara rw’ingenzi mu mubiri wawe kandi gishobora guhindura imbaraga zawe, umutima wawe n’ibimenyetso vyawe.
UnderstandCycle.22: Umubiri wawe uriyorohereza ku mubiri w’imbere w’inda y’umwana.
UnderstandCycle.28: Igi riratanguka. Ni igihe gifise amahirwe menshi yo guhaka.
UnderstandCycle.31: Umubiri wawe uriyegereza ukuntu woshobora guhaka.
UnderstandCycle.33: Uruziga rwawe rushobora guhinduka kuva ku kwezi kuja ku kundi. Guhagarika umutima, ibitotsi, ivyo urya canke uburwayi bishobora guhindura igihe kimara n’uko gikurikirana.
UnderstandCycle.40: Gukurikirana uruziga rwawe mu buryo bworoshe
UnderstandCycle.42: Umviriza umubiri wawe, ube maso ku vyo wumva, kandi wandike ivyo bihinduka uko iminsi igenda.

UnderstandMenstrualFlow.1:
Gusobanukirwa imihango yawe:
ico gikorwa vy’ukuri
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.4: Imihango yawe ni igice c’igikorwa gisanzwe c’ingenzi ku buzima bwa hormone n’ubw’imyororokere. Gusobanukirwa ivyo bibera mu mubiri wawe bishobora kugufasha kumererwa neza muri buri ruziga.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.10: Imihango ni ukuva k’umubiri w’imbere w’inda y’umwana iyo hatabaye gusama. Ibi biba ku rugero rumwe mu kwezi.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.12: Buri mugore aratandukanye: igihe, ubukomezi n’ivyo yumva bishobora guhinduka kuva mu ruziga ukaja mu rundi.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.13: Amaraso ntahora angana mu gihe cose c’imihango yawe. Mu rusangi ahinduka uko iminsi igenda, mu bukomezi, ibara n’uko ameze.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.15: Amaraso akenshi aba menshi mu minsi ya mbere.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.17: Amaraso mu rusangi atangura kugabanuka buhoro buhoro.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.19: Amaraso aba make kandi ashobora gufata ibara ryijimye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.21: Ibi bishobora guhinduka kuva mu ruziga ukaja mu rundi. Icingenzi ni ukumenya uko usanzwe ugenda.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.22: Impinduka zimwe ni zisanzwe mu gihe c’imihango. Ibindi bimenyetso bikwiye kwitonderwa cane, cane cane iyo ari bishasha canke bikomeye cane.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.26: Amaraso menshi mu ntango, hanyuma akaba make.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.28: Kuva ku bukungu bwerurutse kugeza ku bukungu bwijimye canke ibara ry’ikawa hafi y’iherezo ry’imihango yawe.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.30: Ushobora kumva igikomo cyoroheje kugeza ku kiringaniye.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.33: Amaraso yuzuza agatambaro canke tampon vuba cane
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.34: Umunaniro mwinshi, kwumva ugiye kugwa, canke kuzunguruka
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.35: Impinduka itunguranye kandi iguma mu vyo usanzwe umenyereye
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.36: Imigenzo yoroshe irashobora gufasha koroshya ububabare no gutuma iminsi ya mbere y’imihango yawe iba myiza.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.38:
Nywa amazi
ahagije kugira
ugabanye umunaniro.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.39:
Shyira ubushuhe
ku nda yawe
yo hasi igihe bikenewe.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.40:
Gerageza igikorwa
cyoroheje: kugenda,
yoga, kwaguramwo umubiri.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.43: Ikiruhuko, ubushuhe n’igikorwa cyoroheje birashobora gufasha. Iyo ububabare buguma bukomeye cane canke budasanzwe, saba inama z’abaganga.
UnderstandMenstrualFlow.44: Gusobanukirwa imihango yawe: ico gikorwa vy’ukuri — AWA

VaginalRing.12: Impeta ni igikoresho gihindagurika gisohora ubudasiba hormone nkeya mu gitsina, gifise ingaruka imwe ya contraception na pilule ivanze.
VaginalRing.20: Wiyishiramwo wewe nyene, iguma mu mwanya wayo ubudasiba ibyumweru bitatu, hanyuma ikavanwamwo mu kiruhuko c’icumweru kimwe aho imihango yawe iboneka.
VaginalRing.27: Aho iri neza mu gitsina ntikeneye kuba ho neza cane kugira ikore neza, bituma gukoreshwa kwayo koroha.
VaginalRing.28: Impeta ifise ingingo zifatika zitari nke zo kumenya imbere yo kuyihitamwo.
VaginalRing.32: Mu rusangi iguma mu mwanya wayo ibyumweru bitatu.
VaginalRing.34: Hormone zisohoka ubudasiba mu gihe cose c’ikoreshwa.
VaginalRing.36: Kurindwa kwiyongera gushobora gukenerwa hakurikijwe uko biri.
VaginalRing.38: Woza intoke imbere yo kuyishiramwo canke kuyikuramwo
VaginalRing.39: Hitamwo isaha yoroshe kwibuka kugira ukurikirane gahunda
VaginalRing.40: Rimwe na rimwe genzura ko iracari mu mwanya wayo
VaginalRing.41: Raba agapapuro k’ibisobanuro iyo yimutse canke yavuyemwo
VaginalRing.43: Kuvamwo canke kwimuka igihe kirekire bishobora gusaba inama zihariye. Buri gihe raba agapapuro k’igikoresho canke ubaze umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima iyo ushidikanya.
VaginalRing.46: Impeta ushobora kuyiyishiramwo no kuyikuramwo wewe nyene.
VaginalRing.48: Mu rusangi ikurikiza umuzingo w’ibyumweru bitatu hamwe n’ikiruhuko c’icumweru kimwe.
VaginalRing.50: Kugenzura buri gihe ko iri mu mwanya wayo bigufasha gukoresha icigikoresho utuje.
VaginalRing.52: Kurindwa gukwiye gushobora gukenerwa hakurikijwe uko biri.
VaginalRing.54: Vaginal ring ihuza gusohora hormone ubudasiba n’umuzingo wo gukoresha uhosha gufata ikinini buri musi. Nyamara, ihitamwo rya contraception rikwiye guhuzwa na buri muntu no kuvugwako n’umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima.

week1.0: Inda ibarwa kuva ku munsi wa mbere w’imihango yawe ya nyuma, ku mategeko y’abaganga. Kuri iki gihe, gusama mu rusangi ntivyari vyaba.
week1.1: Iki gihe mu rusangi kiba imbere yo gusama; mu rusangi nta mpinduka y’umubiri ijanye n’inda iba iriho.
week1.2: Kubara inda kuva ku mihango ya nyuma bitanga uburyo busanzwe bwo kugereranya itariki yo kubyara, naho gusama kuba hanyuma gatoya.
week1.3: Ni ibisanzwe kutitegereza impinduka iyo ari yo yose kuri iki gihe.

week2.0: Ovulation no gusama bishobora kuba mu rusangi ahagana kuri iki gihe, hakurikijwe uko uruziga rwa buri muntu ruri.
week2.1: Igihe cya ovulation gishobora guhinduka hakurikijwe uko uruziga rungana, bigira ingaruka ku tariki nyayo ushobora gusamiraho.
week2.2: Mu rusangi nta mpinduka y’umubiri yihariye y’inda iriho kuri iki gihe.
week2.3: Igihe nyakuri ca ovulation gitandukana kuri buri muntu, ni co gituma iki gihe gikomeza kuba igereranyo.

week3.0: Iyo gusama kwabaye, igi ritangura kwigabanya no kugenda rija mu nda y’umwana, ariko nta kintu na kimwe gishobora kuboneka n’ikizamini c’inda.
week3.1: Iki cumweru kiracari mu gihe c’ibarwa ry’abaganga kizengurutse gusama; mu rusangi nta kimenyetso c’umubiri kiboneka kuri iki gihe.
week3.2: Ibizamini vy’inda vy’inkari vyinshi bitangura kwizerwa ahagana mu cumweru gikurikira, igihe gutanga kw’inda kwatanguye.

week4.0: Umwana akiri akana yaranguruye mu rukuta rw’inda y’umwana. Agapfunyika k’amazi n’agapfunyika k’umuhondo, bizomugaburira mu minsi ya mbere cane, birimo biraba.
week4.3: Bamwe nta kimenyetso na kimwe barabona kuri iki gihe cya mbere cane.
week4.4: Ikizamini c’inda c’inkari mu rusangi gishobora kuyibona kuva kuri iki cumweru.
week4.5: Iki ni igihe gisanzwe ikizamini c’inda gishobora gutangura gutanga igisubizo c’ “yego”.

week5.0: Sisiteme y’imitsi itangura kuboneka, kandi umutima, ukiri muto cane, ugiye gutera ubwa mbere.
week5.3: Umunaniro udasanzwe, isesemi yoroheje, canke kuribwa amabere vyoshobora kuboneka.
week5.4: Iki ni igihe cagirwa inama co gufata igihe n’umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima kugira utangure gukurikiranwa inda.

week6.0: Utuntu tw’amaboko n’amaguru turatangura kugaragara, hamwe n’udusumbwa duto aho amatwi azoba. Umutima rimwe na rimwe urashobora kumenyekana kuri ultrasound.
week6.3: Isesemi n’umunaniro bishobora kwiyongera kuri bamwe muri iki gihe.
week6.4: Ibikorwa vy’umutima rimwe na rimwe vyoshobora kugaragara kuva kuri iki cumweru kuri ultrasound ya mbere.

week7.0: Ubwonko bukura vuba kuruta ibindi bice vy’umubiri, bigatuma uruhanga ruba runini. Utuntu tw’amaboko dutangura kugaragara ku mpera z’amaboko.
week7.3: Gukunda ibiryo bimwebimwe, canke ukundi gutinya ibiryo bimwebimwe, birashoboka.
week7.4: Umuyoboro w’imitsi, utanga ubwonko n’umugongo, uracari mu gufunga muri ibi byumweru.

week8.0: Umwana ubu yitwa fetus. Amaboko aragenda arekura, umutwe utangura kugororoka gatoya, kandi placenta irakomeza kuboneka.
week8.3: Kwumva impumuro cane n’isesemi yo mu gitondo ni ibisanzwe kuri iki gihe, naho atari ku bose.
week8.4: Ultrasound ya mbere yo kugena itariki mu rusangi ikorwa hagati y’icumweru ca 8 n’ica 14.

week9.0: Ibiranga mu maso biragenda birushiriza kugaragara, ibitsike birinda amaso, kandi amaboko n’ibirenge biragenda bigira ishusho hamwe n’intoke z’ahazaza.
week9.3: Umunaniro mwinshi n’isesemi bishobora kuracaba bihari; akenshi bitangura koroha ahagana mu herezo rya trimestre ya mbere.
week9.4: Ibice vy’imyanya ndangagitsina bitangura kwigaragaza gusa, ariko igitsina mu rusangi ntikimenyekana kugeza hanyuma cane, kuri ultrasound y’umubiri.

week10.0: Mu maso harushiriza kumenyekana, ibitsike bikira ku mucyo, kandi umutima utera vuba, hafi inshuro eshatu kurusha uw’umuntu mukuru.
week10.3: Ukuboko kwawe kwo mu rukenyerero gushobora gutangura guhinduka gatoya, naho inda mu rusangi itaraboneka.
week10.4: Ikizamini cegeranije ca trimestre ya mbere, iyo gitanzwe, mu rusangi gikorwa hagati y’icumweru ca 11 n’ica 14.

week11.0: Intoke z’amaboko n’iz’ibirenge ziratandukana, inzara nto zirakura, kandi placenta igenda yisubiza buhoro buhoro umwanya w’agapfunyika k’umuhondo mu kugaburira umwana.
week11.3: Ushobora kwitegereza impinduka z’umutima, zijanye cane cane n’impinduka za hormone.
week11.4: Ingendo z’umwana zirakwiza gutangura, ariko mu rusangi ntizirumvwa kuri iki gihe.

week12.0: Ingingo z’imbere n’imikaya vyarakuze neza, kandi amagufa atangura gukomera. Ibice vy’imyororokere vyarashizweho, naho bitaboneka kuri ultrasound.
week12.3: Isesemi akenshi itangura koroha buhoro buhoro ahagana kuri iki gihe, naho bitandukanye cane kuri buri muntu.
week12.4: Iherezo rya trimestre ya mbere rirakunze kujanishwa n’ingaruka nkeya zo guhomba inda ugereranije n’ibyumweru vyabanje.

week13.0: Ingendo, zikiri zidahuye, zirakwiza guhuza neza gatoya. Abana bamwe bamaze kugira akamenyero ko konka urutoki.
week13.3: Benshi baragenda basubirana imbaraga nkeya uko trimestre ya kabiri yegereza.
week13.4: Trimestre ya mbere mu rusangi irangira ahagana kuri iki cumweru; gukurikiranwa gukomeza n’amafasi atandukanijwe cane.

week14.0: Umutwe urarushiriza kuba mugari kandi uringaniye n’umubiri wose. Umwana anywa amazi make y’inda, anyura mu gifu no mu bihimba.
week14.3: Inda itangura kugaragara cane kuri bamwe.
week14.4: Umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima rimwe na rimwe ashobora gutangura kumva umutima w’umwana akoresheje igikoresho ca ultrasound gishyizwe ku nda.

week15.0: Umusatsi muto witwa lanugo uragenda upfuka uruhu, kandi ibitsike n’inzara z’amaso bitangura kugaragara. Amaso arumva umucyo.
week15.3: Ubushake bwo kurya bushobora guhinduka, rimwe na rimwe hamwe no gukunda canke gutinya ibiryo bishasha.
week15.4: Kumva gutangura gukura ahagana kuri iki gihe: ijwi ryawe n’amajwi y’imbere mu mubiri biragenda bimenyekana buhoro buhoro.

week16.0: Sisiteme y’imitsi yemerera ingendo z’amaboko n’amaguru. Amaboko ashobora gufunga nk’ingumi ntoya.
week16.3: Bamwe batangura kumva ingendo zoroheje cane kuva ahagana kuri iki gihe, akenshi bisobanurwa nk’ugukubita kw’amababa.
week16.4: Kumva ingendo za mbere bitandukana cane kuva ku nda ukaja ku yindi, cane cane hakurikijwe niba ari inda ya mbere.

week17.0: Amaso, akiri afunze, ashobora kugenda, kandi umwana ubu arumva amajwi manini. Ibimenyetso by’intoke bitangura kuboneka.
week17.3: Umugongo woroheje ushobora kuribwa uko igice c’uburemere bw’umubiri wawe cihinduka.
week17.4: Amajwi yo hanze atangura kumvwa, mu buryo bwuzuyemwo, anyuze mu mazi y’inda.

week18.0: Kumva, gukoraho, kumira n’akamenyero ko konka biragenda bikura. Umwana ararushiriza gukora, afise ingendo nyinshi z’amaboko n’amaguru.
week18.3: Inda akenshi iba igaragara neza kuri iki gihe, kandi igice c’uburemere bw’umubiri wawe kigakomeza guhinduka.
week18.4: Ultrasound y’umubiri, isuzuma ukura kw’umwana muri rusangi, mu rusangi itangwa hagati y’icumweru ca 18 n’ica 21.

week19.0: Amenyo y’ahazaza ahoraho atangura gukura inyuma y’amenyo y’umwana ategurwa, kandi umwana akomeza kwiyongera ibiro buhoro buhoro.
week19.3: Kwumva gukurura ku mpande z’inda (kuribwa kw’umutsi ushyigikira inda) bishobora kuboneka uko inda y’umwana ikura.
week19.4: Iki ni igihe gisanzwe cyo gutangura kumva ingendo z’umwana neza.

week20.0: Kuva kuri iki cumweru, uburebure bupimwa kuva ku mutwe kugeza ku gitsintsiri aho kuva ku mutwe kugeza ku kibuno, kuko amaguru ubu ashobora kurambikwa agapimwa — ibi bisobanura izamuka rigaragara ry’ingano ugereranije n’ibyumweru vyabanje.
week20.3: Inda yawe yashushanye neza ishobora gutangura kugira ingaruka ku buringanire no ku buryo uhagaze.
week20.4: Hagati y’inda akenshi hajanishwa n’isuzuma ryuzuye ry’umuhanga mu vy’ubuzima agukurikirana.

week21.0: Ingendo ziragenda zirushiriza kugaragara no guhuza, kandi ni ibisanzwe gutangura kuzumva neza muri iki gihe.
week21.3: Guhema gato ku murimo bishobora kuboneka uko inda y’umwana ifata umwanya mwinshi.
week21.4: Kumenyera uko umwana wawe asanzwe agenda bituma byoroha kwitegereza impinduka idasanzwe.

week22.0: Ibihaha bikomeza gukura, kandi umwana yimenyereza ingendo nto zo guhema. Ibinyabwoya vy’ururimi na vyo birimo birakura.
week22.3: Gufatwa n’imikaya y’amaguru, cane cane nijoro, birashoboka kuri bamwe.
week22.4: Ivyo urya bishobora guhindura amazi y’inda, umwana anywa buri gihe.

week23.0: Amaguru n’amaboko ubu biringaniye neza. Umwana yimenyereza guhema kandi atangura guhinduranya ibihe vyo gusinzira n’ibyo gukanguka.
week23.3: Umugongo urushiriza kuribwa ushobora kuboneka n’izamuka rya buhoro buhoro ry’ibiro.
week23.4: Kwitegereza ibihe umwana akora n’ibihe atuje bigufasha kumenya umuzingo we.

week24.0: Umwana agera ku rugero rwo kuba ashobora kubaho: mu gihe c’ivuka ritaragera cane kuri iki gihe, ubuvuzi bwihariye bw’abana bavutse bushobora gutuma abaho, hamwe n’ubufasha bukwiye.
week24.3: Igitutu cyongerewe ku mpago n’icipfuzo gikunze cyo kwihagarika bishobora kuboneka.
week24.4: Isuzuma rya diyabete y’inda mu rusangi ritangwa ahagana kuri iki gihe.

week25.0: Umwana ubu arahinda umushitsi canke agatera igitsintsiri iyo yumvise amajwi manini, kandi hiccups zimwe na zimwe zishobora kumvwa. Yihagarika buri gihe mu mazi y’inda.
week25.3: Gutwika mu gifuba canke acid reflux bishobora kuba kenshi.
week25.4: Hiccups z’umwana zumvwa rimwe na rimwe mu rusangi zibonwa nk’izisanzwe.

week26.0: Amaso arakingura ubwa mbere. Ibara ryayo rya nyuma mu rusangi ntirizamenyekana kugeza hashize amezi menshi nyuma y’ivuka.
week26.3: Kubyimba gatoya kw’ibirenge canke utuguru bishobora kuboneka, cane cane ku herezo ry’umusi.
week26.4: Trimestre ya gatatu iregereje, gukurikiranwa n’abaganga mu rusangi biragenda biba kenshi.

week27.0: Ibihaha bigira ubushobozi bwo gutangura guhema, kandi umwana akomeza kwiyongera kuko amavuta yirunda munsi y’uruhu.
week27.3: Umunaniro ushobora kugaruka kuko umubiri wawe wikoreye uburemere bugenda bwiyongera.
week27.4: Intango ya trimestre ya gatatu akenshi ni igihe ciza co gutangura gutekereza ku mugambi wawe wo kubyara.

week28.0: Umutima, wari utera vuba mu ntango z’inda, wahamye ahagana kuri 130 kugeza kuri 140 mu munota kandi ubu urashobora kumvwa na stethoscope.
week28.3: Guhema gatoya canke gutwika mu gifuba bishobora kuba kenshi uko inda y’umwana ifata umwanya mwinshi.
week28.4: Trimestre ya gatatu mu rusangi itangura ahagana kuri iki cumweru, amafasi arushiriza kuba kenshi.

week29.0: Umwana yamaze gushirwaho neza; ibyumweru bikurikira bizoba cane cane ivyo gukura kw’ingingo no kwiyongera ibiro. Agapfunyika gato karinda uruhu rwiwe gatangura gushiramwo.
week29.3: Gusinzira bishobora kugorana kubera inda yawe igenda ikura.
week29.4: Kuruhukira ku ruhande rw’ibumoso akenshi kugirwa inama mu herezo ry’inda kugira ushyigikire gutembera kw’amaraso.

week30.0: Kubona kuracakura; mu kuvuka, umwana azoba ashobora kubona mu maso h’abari hafi, imbere yo kwiga buhoro buhoro gukurikira ibintu bigenda.
week30.3: Kwumva uburemere mu mugongo wo hasi canke mu kibuno bishobora kwiyongera.
week30.4: Amafasi yo gukurikiranwa inda mu rusangi arushiriza kuba kenshi kuva kuri iki gihe.

week31.0: Umwana aragenda cane, rimwe na rimwe yonka intoke, kandi ashobora gukora ingendo nini. Uruhu rwiwe rugabanya iminkanyari uko amavuta yirunda.
week31.3: Ibikoma vyo kwimenyereza, bizwi nka Braxton Hicks, bishobora gutangura kumvwa rimwe na rimwe.
week31.4: Umwana aratangura kumenya amajwi amwe y’abamenyereye yumvwa buri gihe avuye hanze.

week32.0: Umwana yamaze gushirwaho neza kandi aragenda yicara umutwe ujanye hasi ategura ivuka. Cane cane akomeza kwiyongera ibiro mu byumweru bisigaye.
week32.3: Kwiyongera ibiro bigaragara cane ni ibisanzwe muri iki gihe, bijanye n’ukura kw’umwana.
week32.4: Kwicara umutwe ujanye hasi (cephalic) biragenda biba bisanzwe uko igihe cyo kuvuka kigeze.

week33.0: Ubwonko na sisiteme y’imitsi ubu byarakuze neza. Amagufa akomeza gukomera, uretse ay’igihanga, asigara yoroshe kugira byoroshe kunyura mu gihe c’ivuka.
week33.3: Ingorane zo kubona uburyo bworoshe bwo kuryama ni ibisanzwe kuri iki gihe.
week33.4: Ukworoha kw’amagufa y’igihanga mu kuvuka ni uk’akanya gato kandi kugenda gufunga buhoro buhoro mu mwaka wa mbere.
